title: SM972 20 cassava (Lakan 3): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: SM972 20 cassava: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: SM972 20 cassava is a cassava variety from DA and IPB UPLB. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: SM972 20 is a registered cassava variety, also sold or known as Lakan 3 or PSB Cv 12. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 1997 as NSIC 1997 Cv 12. It comes from DA and IPB UPLB. Its record notes 30.6 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

heroImage.alt: Kamote vines on long raised ridges in San Rafael, Bulacan, the kind of farm where SM972 20 cassava is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Lakan 3 or PSB Cv 12, this is the same cassava. The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry, with notes from its seller and farm sources. Compare it with the others in our [cassava variety finder](/crop-varieties/cassava), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for root crops](/land-preparation/root-crop-land-preparation).

items: **Yield:** 30.6 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.caption: From the NSIC registry and its seller

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Its average yield of 30.6 t/ha trails the average of its group, 32.38. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions
rows: Took some damage but held up
Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit cassava fields most often: [whitefly](/pests/whitefly), [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [Cercospora leaf spot](/diseases/cercospora-leaf-spot), [mealybug](/pests/mealybug). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its roots have cream flesh and pink skin. Dry matter is 34.6 percent. A higher dry matter cooks mealy and gives processors more flour or starch from each tonne. Its cyanide level, the HCN content, is low. A low level is safer for the table, while a high level calls for peeling, soaking and full cooking. It is recommended .
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Fruit:** Cream flesh, pink skin, dry matter about 34.6 percent, low HCN.
**Where:** All regions, best in Southern Mindanao.
Moderately resistant to brown leaf spot and spider mite.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: low cyanide food and feed variety that was multiplied for San Miguel's cassava feed project in Negros Occidental. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant SM972 20 cassava

The registry recommends it for anywhere in the country. Pick by buyer first. Starch and feed plants pay for yield and starch content, while the table wants a sweet, low cyanide variety that boils soft. A high starch variety needs a buyer within a day of harvest, because the roots spoil fast.

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Lakan 3 the same as SM972 20?
items.a: Yes. Lakan 3 is another name for SM972 20, registered as NSIC 1997 Cv 12. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
The record shows 30.6 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
The registry recommends it for anywhere in the country. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of SM972 20?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
